tracks.attribution: "Satiate - only strings" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) — Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
tracks.description: I piece unlike anything I've done, this is a very difficult piece to process emotionally. It just never lets the audience rest. There are a lot of uses for this sort of piece.  It is also available with percussion, which gives it a more immediacy.

tracks.title: Seven March
tracks.attribution: "Seven March" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) — Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
tracks.description: A piece in 7/8 time with 2-measure phrasing. Very dark and round sounding with randomly placed percussions.

tracks.title: Spy Groove
tracks.attribution: "Spy Groove" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) — Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
tracks.description: Aggressive drum kit sound with warmth added by a B3 organ and conga. Modulation in the final repeat.

tracks.title: Stay the Course
tracks.attribution: "Stay the Course" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) — Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
tracks.description: A low rumble marks the seconds. Out of nowhere comes nothing! Just a continuous ominous force, never seen. You can see the ominous force if you sprinkle some iron filing around.

tracks.title: Thinking Music
tracks.attribution: "Thinking Music" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) — Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
tracks.description: Comedic "hard thinking" music. Chances are you won't need the entire piece if you are making a film. I made it so you can cut it up into different sounding sections of various seriousness. If you're using it for a video game, everything flows together well, or you could loop sections that work best.

tracks.title: Very Low Note
tracks.attribution: "Very Low Note" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) — Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
tracks.description: Just a very low note (a C) to be used as a bed for any very unnerving and dark scene.

tracks.title: Back on Track
tracks.attribution: "Back on Track" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) — Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
tracks.description: A percussion-loaded piece with a cut out in the middle for dialog (or whatever you like).

tracks.title: Bushwick Tarantella Loop
tracks.attribution: "Bushwick Tarantella Loop" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) — Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
tracks.description: An Italian piece that was made nowhere near Italy. Fast, bright and fun! A longer non-looping version is available.

tracks.title: Cipher
tracks.attribution: "Cipher" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) — Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
tracks.description: I've been told this is R&B, but could be a few other things. It is certainly pretty neat. Warning: Very sticky hook.

tracks.title: Fig Leaf Rag
tracks.attribution: "Fig Leaf Rag" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) — Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
tracks.description: The classic ragtime ditty of Scott Joplin, perfect for a silent film of whimsy and humor. The piece begins with a short intro, then plays the bouncy rhythm of with a bright plodding beat. At the end of the third minute, the pace quickens, and leads into a darker refrain, but the jolly melody returns

tracks.title: Flying Kerfuffle
tracks.attribution: "Flying Kerfuffle" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) — Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
tracks.description: Happy happy, happy happiness. Happier, happiest? Happy. Now that the word has lost all meaning, take a listen to this thing. It is dripping with joy. tracks.title: Nonstop
tracks.attribution: "Nonstop" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) — Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
tracks.description: From what I can tell, this piece has no genre... it is an odd mix of a few things, but not enough of any one of them to be considered a member of that group. So, when you find a new critter which is certainly a new species... likely a new genus... probably a new family... and seriously might be a or

tracks.title: Paradise Found
tracks.attribution: "Paradise Found" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) — Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
tracks.description: This piece of music never stops smiling. It is a happy, dancy, and never over-the-top party opener! The bass will move people. I found the "Tropical House" genre on some AI music site, and put this together. Overall, I'm a fan!

tracks.title: Peppy Pepe
tracks.attribution: "Peppy Pepe" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) — Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
tracks.description: Hideously happy Latin piece. Nice trombone solo. Lots of auxiliary percussion.

tracks.title: Rainbows
tracks.attribution: "Rainbows" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) — Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
tracks.description: Light and refreshing as a summer's day! I really just should lift ad copy for laundry detergent and fabric softener for this one. Springtime Fresh Scent! Pure and Simple! Brightens! Gentle on Fabrics! Great Value! Easy-pour Bottle! Marimbas!

tracks.title: Shiny Tech
tracks.attribution: "Shiny Tech" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) — Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
tracks.description: Electronica (techo-pop dance). This is a fast and energetic piece polished almost to a fault. Lots of synth, and a happy clave. Think fashion show runway. Works best loud, works also not so loud.

tracks.title: Theme for Harold (var. 3)
tracks.attribution: "Theme for Harold (var. 3)" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) — Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
tracks.description: Simple simple 8-bit theme. This is the fastest "Boss Level" version of the three. It was originally written by a puppet, so mostly black keys, which are easier for a puppet to play.

tracks.title: Voice Over Under
tracks.attribution: "Voice Over Under" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) — Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
tracks.description: This is a piece of music classified as "GNDN". Goes Nowhere. Does Nothing. It sort of sits there and just repeats mild variants. There isn't even an ending.  Yet, this was all on purpose. This piece was designed for keeping energy in news reports or review segments where there is a lot of talking. T

tracks.title: Expeditionary
tracks.attribution: "Expeditionary" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) — Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
tracks.description: A sort of African/European salad mix of sounds.

tracks.title: Mystery Bazaar
tracks.attribution: "Mystery Bazaar" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) — Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
tracks.description: Well met, traveller! Come warm by my brazier... Is that a Djinn in your pocket, or are you just happy to see me? Hah! I have a joke with you! ...unless it is a djinn - then you must leave immediately! ...unless that would offend the djinn - then you must stay! ...unless the djinn is going to kill me

tracks.title: Suonatore di Liuto
tracks.attribution: "Suonatore di Liuto" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) — Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
tracks.description: Simple little background lute piece.

tracks.title: Temple of the Manes
tracks.attribution: "Temple of the Manes" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) — Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
tracks.description: An ancient-feeling modal piece.

tracks.title: Thunderhead
tracks.attribution: "Thunderhead" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) — Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
tracks.description: Native American drumming. The branch rattle is reminiscent of thunder. Tempo picks up about halfway through.
